In this meeting of the minds, we talk about Benny's journey, the grand conspiracy and how to detox ourselves from its poisons, what it's like to have a newborn in 2020, and much more. Benny also shares some profound poetry!
ext: We discuss whether babies should receive injections, birth certificates, or US citizenship. Other topics include the Bible, cyber attacks, communism's relation to the lockdowns, the great conjunction and much more.
